title: Depth-observability admission criterion for UAV visual-inertial odometry: code, notebook and results
description: Code, Colab notebook and per-run results for the paper "A Depth-Observability Admission Criterion for UAV Visual-Inertial Odometry" (G. Briia, I. Turkin, O. Liubimov, ISEAS / ISUN-AI 2026). A monocular MSCKF is run on 17 EuRoC MAV and TUM-VI sequences under different landmark-admission settings (816 deterministic runs); the notebook reproduces every table and number of the paper.
